dialogues.speaker: A Recruitment Drive
dialogues.text: Hey! Is your life boring you to tears? Join us now! Let's unearth Dr. Mosso's mysterious legacy from thirty years ago!

dialogues.speaker: A Recruitment Drive
dialogues.text: Let me make this clear, this isn't a scam! And if you're to be any idiot, then I guarantee that you'll be the greatest idiot among idiots!

dialogues.speaker: A Recruitment Drive
dialogues.text: If you're an elite, doubtless all other elites shall find themselves wanting before you!

dialogues.speaker: A Recruitment Drive
dialogues.text: Let me repeat myself again, this is not a scam! Don't miss this golden opportunity! I'll be waiting for you at Fleuve Cendre!
